notes.title: 🎉 Hidden Heir Patch Released! 🎮
notes.notes:
We've just released a new patch based on your valuable feedback. This update brings several improvements and enhancements to make your journey even more immersive. 👑

📌 What's New in This Update:

Various balancing changes and quality-of-life improvements requested by players.

Bug fixes and better performance overall.

Character and quest tweaks to improve gameplay flow.

🗡️ Special Note: A New Sword Awaits in the First Cave!
A powerful new sword has been added to the first cave. This weapon allows for unique combo attacks not available with standard gear. However, claiming it won’t be easy — you’ll need to overcome several obstacles to reach it. Are you up to the challenge?

Thanks again to everyone who continues to support Hidden Heir. Your feedback drives the future of this world, and we’re excited to keep building it with you! 🛠️

🎮 Download the patch now and see what’s new – and don’t forget to let us know what you think.
⚔️ Your kingdom awaits!

notes.title: 🎉 HIDDEN HEIR – FINAL VERSION IS LIVE! 🎉
notes.notes:
New Skills. New Combos. The Entire Map is Now Unlocked!

After a long journey, everything is finally ready.
With the final release of Hidden Heir, prepare for dark secrets, legendary battles, and unforgettable moments. 👑

🔓 Full World Unlocked: Explore every corner of the map, uncover mysteries, and face your destiny.
🗡️ Brand-New Combo Skills: Tear through your enemies with new, fluid combat mechanics. Feel like a true warrior!
🔥 New Abilities & Surprise Powers: Customize your fighting style and shape your character’s future.

Everything is now in your hands. Rise from the shadows of betrayal and claim your fate!
This is not the end — it's just the beginning...

🛡️ Update now and write your own legend!

notes.title: 📢 UPDATE NOTES – Hidden Heir
notes.notes:
Thanks to your valuable feedback, we’ve rolled out performance and visual improvements. Several reported bugs and issues have been fixed.
Don’t forget to update the game for a smoother and more visually refined experience! 💫

🛠️ What’s new in this update:

Performance optimization

Enhanced graphics and lighting

Fixed some environmental glitches

Resolved gameplay-related bugs

Improved FPS and faster loading

🧙‍♀️ Your journey is now smoother than ever! Keep the feedback coming.
